creators.name: Kaining Ying
creators.role: Researcher at Fudan University; first author of WBench
creators.bio: First author of WBench (2026), a multi-turn benchmark and public leaderboard for interactive video world models built by Fudan University and Meituan's LongCat team.
creators.why: Gives interactive world models a shared multi-turn test across text, pose and keyboard control.
creators.role_zh: 复旦大学研究者，WBench 第一作者
creators.bio_zh: WBench（2026）的第一作者。WBench 是复旦大学与美团 LongCat 团队构建的交互视频世界模型多轮评测基准，并设有公开排行榜。
creators.why_zh: 为交互世界模型提供一套跨文字、位姿与键盘控制的通用多轮测试。

creators.name: Kaixin Ding
creators.bio: First author of PlayWorld (2026), a benchmark from Kuaishou and the University of Hong Kong in which multimodal agents play world models toward long-horizon objectives.
creators.why: Evaluates world models by what an agent can accomplish inside them.
creators.bio_zh: PlayWorld（2026）的第一作者。PlayWorld 是快手与香港大学推出的基准，让多模态智能体在世界模型中追求长时程目标。
creators.why_zh: 以智能体能在世界模型中完成什么来评估世界模型。

creators.name: Jianjie Fang
creators.role: Researcher at Tsinghua University; first author of iWorld-Bench
creators.bio: First author of iWorld-Bench (ICML 2026), a benchmark and leaderboard for the interaction abilities of world models released under Tsinghua's EmbodiedCity project.
creators.why: Makes world models with different control interfaces comparable on distance perception and memory.
creators.role_zh: 清华大学研究者，iWorld-Bench 第一作者
creators.bio_zh: iWorld-Bench（ICML 2026）的第一作者。该基准与排行榜用于评测世界模型的交互能力，在清华大学 EmbodiedCity 项目下发布。
creators.why_zh: 让控制接口不同的世界模型能在距离感知与记忆上相互比较。

creators.name: Jinpeng Lu
creators.bio: First author of 'Current World Models Lack a Persistent State Core' (2026), which introduces the WRBench diagnostic benchmark; the project page lists USTC, CASIA, X-Humanoid and TU Dresden among the contributing institutions.
creators.why: Tests whether generated worlds keep evolving when they are not being watched.
creators.bio_zh: 论文《Current World Models Lack a Persistent State Core》（2026）的第一作者，该文提出诊断性基准 WRBench；项目主页列出的参与机构包括中国科学技术大学、中国科学院自动化研究所、X-Humanoid 与德累斯顿工业大学。
creators.why_zh: 检验生成的世界在无人注视时是否仍在继续演化。

works.title: WBench
works.description: A multi-turn benchmark for interactive world models from Fudan University and Meituan's LongCat team: 289 cases with 1,058 interaction turns (navigation, subject actions, event edits, perspective switches) scored on video quality, setting and interaction adherence, consistency and physics. It runs a public leaderboard, and its paper finds that none of 20 tested models is strong on every dimension.
works.description_zh: 复旦大学与美团 LongCat 团队推出的交互世界模型多轮基准：289 个用例、1058 个交互轮次（导航、主体动作、事件编辑、视角切换），从视频质量、设定遵循、交互遵循、一致性与物理合理性五个维度打分。它设有公开排行榜，论文发现受测的 20 个模型没有一个在所有维度上都表现出色。
works.idea_en: Tests a world model the way a session unfolds, turn after turn, and lets text-, pose- and keyboard-driven models be compared on the same cases.
works.idea_zh: 按体验实际展开的方式逐轮测试世界模型，并让文字、位姿与键盘驱动的模型在同一批用例上比较。
works.method: Each case specifies a world setting and a multi-turn interaction sequence in first or third person; navigation is unified across text, 6-DoF pose and discrete actions; 22 automatic sub-metrics combine specialist vision models with large multimodal models and are validated against human judgments.
works.method_zh: 每个用例规定一个世界设定和一段第一或第三人称的多轮交互序列；导航指令在文字、六自由度位姿与离散动作之间统一；22 项自动子指标结合专用视觉模型与多模态大模型，并经过人工评判校验。
works.specs: 289 cases · 1,058 turns · 5 dimensions · 22 sub-metrics · leaderboard: 44 Navigation and 16 Full entries (updated 2026-10-12), several top entries self-evaluated

paper.title: WBench: A Comprehensive Multi-turn Benchmark for Interactive Video World Model Evaluation

works.title: PlayWorld
works.description: A benchmark from Kuaishou and the University of Hong Kong in which multimodal AI agents play world models toward long-horizon goals across 171 scenarios, such as turning a full circle to check the scene or wading into water to look for ripples. Tested on nine models including Genie 3, HappyOyster and HY-World 2, it finds them unreliable on long-horizon interaction.
works.description_zh: 快手与香港大学推出的基准：让多模态 AI 智能体在 171 个情境中操控世界模型、追求长时程目标，例如原地转一圈检查场景是否一致，或走进水里看是否出现涟漪。在包括 Genie 3、HappyOyster 与 HY-World 2 在内的九个模型上测试后发现，它们在长时程交互上仍不可靠。
works.idea_en: Judges a world model by what an agent can accomplish in it, which is fairer to models with different controls than replaying a fixed action list.
works.idea_zh: 以智能体能在世界模型里完成什么来评判它；对于控制方式各异的模型，这比回放固定动作序列更公平。
works.method: Agent players choose their own actions to reach each scenario's objective; models are scored on geometry consistency, interaction fidelity, and in-sight and out-of-sight evolution, plus basic video-quality and controllability metrics.
works.method_zh: 智能体玩家自行选择动作以达成每个情境的目标；模型从几何一致性、交互保真度以及视野内与视野外的演化等维度评分，并辅以视频质量与可控性等基础指标。

paper.title: PlayWorld: Benchmarking World Models with Agent Players over Long-Horizon Objectives

works.title: iWorld-Bench
works.description: An ICML 2026 benchmark from Tsinghua University for the interaction abilities of world models: 330K collected clips, 2.1K curated samples across perspectives, weather and scenes, and 4.9K test samples in six task types covering visual quality, trajectory following and memory. An action-generation framework lets models with different control interfaces be tested alike, and 14 models are on its public leaderboard.
works.description_zh: 清华大学在 ICML 2026 发表的世界模型交互能力基准：收集 33 万段视频，精选 2100 个覆盖不同视角、天气与场景的样本，构造六类任务共 4900 个测试样本，涵盖画面质量、轨迹跟随与记忆。它用一个“动作生成框架”让控制接口不同的模型能被同样测试，公开排行榜上有 14 个模型。
works.idea_en: Translates one test into each model's own control language, so camera-, keyboard- and text-driven world models can be compared on distance perception and memory.
works.idea_zh: 把同一个测试翻译成各个模型自己的控制方式，使相机、键盘与文字驱动的世界模型能在距离感知与记忆上比较。
works.method: An Action Generation Framework converts each task into the input modality a model accepts; six task types are scored with metrics such as brightness and color-temperature consistency, trajectory alignment and memory symmetry.
works.method_zh: “动作生成框架”把每个任务转换为模型可接受的输入形式；六类任务用亮度与色温一致性、轨迹对齐、记忆对称性等指标评分。
works.specs: 330K clips · 2.1K curated samples · 4.9K test samples · 6 task types · 14 models

paper.title: iWorld-Bench: A Benchmark for Interactive World Models with a Unified Action Generation Framework

works.title: WRBench
works.description: A diagnostic benchmark that asks whether a generated world keeps evolving while the camera looks away. Across 9,600 videos from 23 models and four control paradigms, it finds that current systems behave like a tracking shot: a returning object reappears in the state it was left in instead of having advanced the event that was under way.
works.description_zh: 一个诊断性基准，检验相机移开时生成的世界是否仍在继续演化。在来自 23 个模型、四种控制范式的 9600 段视频中，它发现当前系统表现得像跟拍镜头：重新看到的物体停留在被离开时的状态，而不是让原本进行中的事件继续推进。
works.idea_en: Separates looking consistent from being a world: an event should run its course even when no one is watching, and today's models do not do that.
works.idea_zh: 把“看起来一致”与“真正是一个世界”区分开：即使无人注视，事件也应继续发展，而当今的模型做不到。
works.method: Treats camera motion as an intervention on observability and scores a human-calibrated chain: does the camera execute the requested move, does the scene stay continuous and identifiable while in view, and is a returning target consistent with the event that was set in motion.
works.method_zh: 把相机运动视为对“可观测性”的干预，并按经人工校准的链条逐级评分：相机是否执行了要求的动作，场景在视野内是否连续且可辨认，以及重新出现的目标是否与此前启动的事件相符。

paper.title: Current World Models Lack a Persistent State Core
